description: Two-route cross-pin of the c₃ bar-odd A_ω datum. Route A = smooth ladder S = c3_target + Vol41 (the TARGET swing S_p/S_m ≈ -4.0751). Route B = the scale-invariant local Φ_b quasi-period readout qpRatio = Φ_b(z0+ib)/Φ_b(z0) at the substrate b-map (arg b = +π/4), validated evaluator. RESULT: the local qpRatio cross-anchor ratio is 1 - 3e-9 (anchor-BLIND) — it supplies neither the S swing nor any pre-named integer/count ratio. Scope-(a): the c₃ bar-odd swing is NOT in the local Φ_b monodromy but in the dual/large-arg (Stokes) monodromy — the 3d-index/GGM face owned by siblings #3805/#3826. Empirically confirms QOU.QBeta.MonodromyDatumRigidity (local readout solution/anchor-independent) and the non-perturbative phase law (c821747763). No fit; no c_k wired; consumes #3826 I_Δ(0,0) only as a cited reference.

consumed_reference_3826.note: assembly of A_ω from the 3d-index (flux-sum gluing) is sibling-owned (#3805/#3826); NOT touched here

data.verdict: SCOPE-(a) NEGATIVE (local monodromy excluded as swing carrier). The local scale-invariant Φ_b quasi-period readout is anchor-blind (ratio 1 - 3e-9), reproducing neither the S swing (-4.0751) nor any pre-named integer/count. The c₃ bar-odd A_ω swing is therefore in the DUAL/large-argument (Stokes) monodromy — the 3d-index/GGM face (siblings #3805/#3826), NOT the local quasi-period. This is the empirical companion of MonodromyDatumRigidity (local readout solution-independent) + the non-perturbative phase law. It does NOT compute A_ω (sibling-owned assembly); it excludes the one datum computable fit-free with in-repo Φ_b infra. No fit; no c_k.
